instrument_explainer: The repo rate is the rate at which the Reserve Bank of India lends overnight to banks against government securities. The Monetary Policy Committee sets it six times a year to keep inflation close to its 4% target. Most new floating-rate retail loans are priced off it.
coverage_note: Every MPC decision from 4 Oct 2016 from its official resolution; earlier rate changes from earlier published histories, with secondary sources labelled. Historical announcement times use 10:00 IST as a convention.
